description: Develop and maintain scalable microservices using Spring Boot and reactive programming with RxJava. Responsible for implementing data structures in Azure SQL and integrating asynchronous messaging via Apache Kafka for external service communication. Manage service deployments on Kubernetes (AKS) clusters through Jenkins pipelines, ensuring high code quality with unit and integration testing (JUnit/Mockito) within an Agile (Scrum) environment.

Developed robust REST APIs using Spring Boot and JPA/Hibernate for data persistence across Oracle and SQL Server. Built dynamic, responsive user interfaces with Angular and Tailwind CSS. Implemented security layers using Spring Security and JWT, while optimizing data retrieval through the implementation of stored procedures.

Executed end-to-end web development using PHP and the CodeIgniter framework. Developed interactive dashboards with JQuery and ChartJS, including automated dynamic report generation (PDF/CSV). Implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and ensured mobile-first responsiveness using Bootstrap 5.

Developed modular components and libraries in Java following Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles. Focused on consuming third-party APIs and ensuring data integrity through comprehensive testing in Postman and optimized SQL query execution for internal data processing.

Collaborated on technical analysis and business logic implementation in Java. Standardized development workflows via Git and executed technical tests on service endpoints to ensure seamless communication between internal and external systems.
